limitations: Skill contains no explicit link to the installed package guide it requires.
No catalogue or inspection-client discovery API syntax is documented by the skill. Default page exposes no Inspector-like window names.
Fixture exposes reset and profile-switch remounts, but no editor-only dispose or unmount control. Full disposal cannot be proven through available visible controls.
Fixture has unobserved decorations and NodeViews and no visible overlay activation control. An active overlay surviving remount could not be tested.
Only protocol 1 and recording format 1 are exposed. Inspector and ProseMirror dependency package versions are not reported by the visible UI or exported recording.
